description: This file defines a React component for a settings page, including handling logging callbacks, alerting configurations, webhook URLs, and UI interactions such as modals and forms. It manages fetching and updating callback configurations, rendering various UI sections, and handling user actions related to notifications and callback management.

methods.name: DynamicParamsFields

methods.name: CallbackSelector
methods.description: Reusable React component for selecting a callback from a list with search and logo display.

methods.name: getDynamicParamsForCallback
methods.description: Helper function to retrieve dynamic parameters for a given callback configuration.

methods.name: buildCallbackPayload
methods.description: Helper function to construct the payload for callback API requests based on form values.
